messages:
Sam: There's now a tiny knit scarf on the pigeon by the north ledge. Whoever's doing this is an absolute hero.
Priya: knit scarf?? show pic pls
Ken: posted in #random-photos — small, tasteful, very regal.
Diana: we should knight it. "Ledgelord" has a nice ring.
Eli: Ledgelord or Lady Ledger? tough call.
Zoe: vote poll: Ledgelord / Lady Ledger / Sir Featherbottom
Sam: +1 Ledgelord
Priya: Lady Ledger, but if it insists on pecking my lunch I reserve the right to rename.
Ken: OpsBot: Reminder: do not tie items to wildlife. If the scarf was put on intentionally it could be unsafe.
OpsBot: OpsBot: Automated notice from Facilities — please don't attach items to birds. Report sightings to facilities@redwood.com.
Diana: facilities already notified, they said they'd check the ledge tomorrow morning.
Eli: In the meantime, can we make membership cards? "Friend of Ledgelord" with holographic crumbs.
Zoe: I can make stickers. Also propose a tiny ritual: every time Ledgelord appears, we quietly applaud and leave one cracker on the courtyard bench.
Priya: stealth cracker distribution logistics: who will be the Crumb Liaison?
Sam: i'll volunteer. title: Crumb Liaison. badge: tiny Post-it with a feather doodle.
Ken: I'll design the badge. Colors: pigeon gray + snack yellow.
Diana: Also, unrelated: Stan the Monstera waved a leaf at me today. Stan approves.
Priya: Standing ovation for Stan and Ledgelord.
Eli: Ceremony tomorrow at 12:05pm (short, dignified). Attendance: optional but crackers encouraged.
Zoe: putting a calendar invite now. emoji reaction: :crown:
Sam: perfect. Ledgelord will be ordained. Long live the Ledgelord. :bird:
